text_block_list.text:
"On Christmas Day.
As for Air Messiah and myself—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, over there.
—Mother!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Messiah, Trainer!
I'm so sorry you had to come pick me up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No, no... was it really all right, I wonder?
Something like this――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To think that, setting you aside, even I would be invited
to a gathering of nothing but prestigious families
and Umamusume who define the era.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?
Without you, Mother, I wouldn't be who I am today.
choice_data_list: Now, let us head to the venue together.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Many people have already mentioned that they would like to speak with your mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
I'm honored, but... hehe, I might get a little nervous.
Indeed. We had been invited to a social gathering with distinguished Umamusume and the prestigious families that produced them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Messiah, you're back... Wait.
Could that lady over there be—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My, Air Groove!
I've heard so much about you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. I have heard
much about you from my mother as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I would be honored to speak with you directly tonight.
Particularly regarding your coaching philosophy for the Umamusume Club.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if there is anything I can tell you.
Pleased to meet you, Air Groove-san.
...By the way, is your mother here today as well...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, she's here, but...
Mother is rather lively, or rather, she just can't sit still...
Shall I go look for her?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! Hehe, I see...
You haven't changed a bit, have you?

The renowned "Empress" Air Groove, and her mother.
And among others—

Spearheaded by Daiichi Ruby,
the members of the renowned "Splendid Clan."
The people who look like foreign dignitaries are most likely affiliated with Fine Motion.

On top of that, the place was filled with guests
radiating such noble auras that just seeing them
made one want to straighten up their posture—

However, even with all that said, the one commanding
an exceptional level of attention in this venue was, after all—

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
"That was a truly magnificent victory at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
It is an honor to meet the Autumn Queen who graces our era."

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Carrying on the will of your great mother, running your heart out... I was deeply moved by the sight.
Please, allow me to hear more about your story.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —It is an honor.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee C
text_block_list.text:
So you are Trainer <username>...!
Ah, it is a pleasure to finally meet you.
To achieve such success as a rookie is truly splendid.
choice_data_list: No, it's all because of her hard work...!

text_block_list.text:
Guests continuously flocked around Air Messiah,
her mother, and me, eager to hear all sorts of stories.

To be honest, I wasn't used to places like this,
and surrounded by such refined guests,
I felt completely out of place, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, that strategy was per my Trainer's instructions.
—Indeed. I certainly felt the pressure, but—

"Her consistency is second to none after all.
It reminded me once again that having such an unshakeable,
solid foundation is truly her greatest strength."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, but you know, Trainer...
That girl used to be sooooo... extremely shy back then.

As I found myself lost in admiration, she casually whispered that into my ear.
...It was a story almost impossible to believe.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes, she's very dependable. ...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"When I was little... Yeah, like the very first day
I showed up at the youth club—
oh man, it was incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She was especially terrified of the instructor.
No matter how much I tried to soothe her, she just shook her head no and clung to my back the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder when it started.
Even when startled by meeting someone new,
she stopped hiding behind me or Big Brother's back."
choice_data_list: It must be because she worked hard to change.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: She's always like that. ...That girl.

A short while later, the crowd surrounding us finally
thinned out, so we decided to leave the venue
and take a brief break.
choice_data_list: Good work, Messiah. Let's relax a little, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... That makes sense, I'll do that.

With a slightly dazed expression,
Air Messiah let out a slow, deep breath.
...Understandably, she was exhausted.

"I want to let her zone out for a little while.
Without saying anything in particular, I decide to simply stand quietly by her side."
And so, a brief silence fell—
...Or so you'd think.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Messiah-san!
So this is where you were!!

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee D
text_block_list.text:
"No, sorry to interrupt while you're relaxing!
My daughter just insisted on speaking with you—"

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee D
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh?

...Of course, that wasn't the case.
And yet, she had undoubtedly vanished
from that very spot—
(Squeeze)

A soft breath. The hem of my formal suit lightly pinched.
A faint warmth felt on my back...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. Pardon me.
Um... did you want to talk...?

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee D
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah... N-No no no!
I should be the one apologizing for being so rude all of a sudden!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
――Well, I should be heading off around now.
Thank you so much for today!
Goodbye... See you later, Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes. I'll get in touch again.

Air Messiah's mother leaves in a taxi.
The party ended safely, and though I've successfully
seen her off like this—

...Ever since then,
Air Messiah has been acting a little strange.
She seemed completely fine when dealing with guests or her mother, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list: (I sense a slight distance between us...!?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Um, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Would you mind... if we took a short detour?
And so, accompanied by Air Messiah who still seemed a little off, we arrived in front of the square decorated in Christmas colors.

In a voice almost drowned out by the bustle,
she mumbled hesitantly—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I intended to give this to you at the venue...
but given the situation, or rather the timing...
...Anyway, I missed my chance.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Uhm. So, in any case—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Here you go, Trainer.

What Air Messiah gave me was...
a simple scarf that felt wonderful to the touch.

Her wonderfully sensible Christmas gift felt so
typical of her, bringing a fond smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's been especially chilly lately.
...Please, make sure to keep yourself warm.
When I wrapped it around my neck right away, Air Messiah gave a somewhat relieved smile.
Surprised, I check the contents of the bag handed to me. Inside was—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... If I may say so myself, it's hand-knitted.

"I'm amazed by how painstakingly crafted it looks.
...However, even with that in mind, this shape isâ"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It's an elephant.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I live on a southern island.

Indeed, the meticulously hand-knitted elephant
wore a cute straw hat on its head,
complete with a hibiscus-patterned ribbon.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...How is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A hand-knitted item itself is...
a classic Christmas present.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However, most people usually go for scarves, sweaters, hats, or socks, so intentionally choosing a plushie—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Also, rather than common plushies
like dogs or cats,
I deliberately chose an elephant here―

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And since it's Christmas, we should intentionally add
southern island elements to evoke a tropical vibe—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I tried to take the plunge in various ways, but.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...How was it, I wonder?

To be honest—I didn't quite get it.
Isn't a hand-knitted yarn plushie
pretty much a classic staple anyway?

The elephant was certainly surprising, but was the
tropical island element truly necessary?
What is a sound idea, and what is wild recklessness—
choice_data_list: (I don't get it... Plushies are cute, though...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—No, I'm sorry.
I'm so sorry... I've troubled you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um... I understand that.
Even if I try to take the plunge, it's bound to turn out clumsy, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to force yourself to do so in the first place," they said.
...I understand that deep down.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even on Valentine's Day...
you still accepted that gift of mine,
which was hardly pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Because of who I am, there are things only I can achieve, things only I can convey...
I understand that, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even though I knew.
This time of all times—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I just thought... "I want to give you
something lovely and memorable."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The incident at the party is just another example of that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To think I hid behind your back...
Showing such disgraceful behavior...
is something I haven't done since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why.
Why does this only ever happen with you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Truly... why could that be—?
